version.changelog: Update distribution guidance, add launch asset checklist, and strengthen platform-claim boundaries.

llm.summary: This is a document-only podcast planning guide with no executable code, API use, persistence, or hidden high-impact behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request local file access, credentials, network authority, external APIs, posting authority, or mutation privileges; its guidance is proportionate to podcast planning.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package metadata describes a normal document-only skill; inspected files show no handlers, scripts, dependencies, executable entry points, or remote payload installation.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger keywords include broad terms such as podcast, storytelling, and broadcasting, which may cause over-broad activation, but the loaded instructions are informational and low-impact.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence mechanisms, background workers, memory writes, scheduled tasks, tool wrapping, privilege escalation, or cross-session behavior were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is end-to-end podcast launch guidance, and the artifact content stays within concept, format, equipment, recording, editing, hosting, distribution, launch QA, and growth advice.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Installers should treat this as an English podcast launch checklist and advisory guide. It does not run code or connect to services, but users should independently verify current podcast platform submission rules before relying on directory guidance.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The English-primary acceptance criterion is a locale and accessibility limitation rather than a security concern; it is disclosed in review criteria and does not create hidden authority or unsafe behavior.
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger keywords are a real UX scoping note, but for this document-only skill they would at most surface benign podcast guidance in loosely related conversations.
[SQP-3] expected: The manifest language value of en matches the English artifact content; users who need another language should be aware of the limitation, but it is not purpose-mismatched or high-impact.
